(ta)༄༅/ /dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi gtor chog dang rjes gnang bya tshul gyi cho ga'i phyag len bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pa

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi gtor chog dang rjes gnang bya tshul gyi cho ga'i phyag len bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rje btsun sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi bsnyen pa mchod gtor bsdus pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las 'khor lo bde mchog gam bla med gang rung gi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi legs par thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pa'i slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ thog mar 'di'i rjes su gnang ba byin te de nas nyams su blang ba'i tshul ni/ sngon du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed srung 'khor dang yi dam gyi sgom bzlas ci nus byas la/ yi dam chos skyong che chung gi mchod gtor gyi rjes la sngon du 'di'i gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa'am/ yang na sngon du chos skyong bskyed na/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar hūm̐ yig las e chad pa las nam mkha'/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ ra las rak+ta'i rgya mtsho/ sum̐ las zhing chen gyi sa gzhi/ keṃ las keng rus kyi ri rab/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ brūm̐ las thod mkhar gyi gzhal yas khang mi mgo skam po las grub pa'i gru bzhi pa/ mi rus kyi ka ba dang rtsibs rus sna tshogs kyi steng thog phub pa/ thod skam gyi mda' yab dang pu shus brgyan cing glo snying dang rgyu rlon gyi drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ 'og tu rus pa dang sha khrag sna tshogs kyis gcal du bkram pa/ de'i nang du pad+ma maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ gis pad+ma'i gdan/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis nyi ma'i gdan/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la hūm̐ gis zla ba'i gdan gnyis su gyur/ gdan gyi steng du sa bon hūm̐ dang am̐ las dung dang mgron bu hūm̐ dang am̐ gyis mtshan pa las dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gnyis sku mdog dkar zhing 'od zer 'phro ba/
keng rus shin tu brjid pa'i gzugs can phyag gnyis pa/

rje grol mchog gi bzhed pa spyan gsum/ spyan bgrad cing ljags 'dril ba/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyis thod skam gyi dbyug pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba thugs kar bsnams shing zhal du gsol ba/ zhabs g.yas bskums pas g.yon brkyangs pa'i brla la brten pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang*/ thod skam lnga dang rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang snyan chas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i yab yum 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba gnyis su gyur/ de gnyis kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las dang rang gi snying ga nas/ 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas dang*/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i yul nas dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum 'khor 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pas bskor ba nas oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ hūm̐/ dpal ldan mthu stobs dbang phyug che// phrin las rnam bzhis don mdzad pa// dang ldan dam tshig chen po yi// gnas 'di nyid du gshegs su gsol// shrī sh+ma sha na a dhi pa ta ye e h+ye hi/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/ gnyis su med par bstim/ rang skad cig gis yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros dbang gi lha 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing*/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs kyis dbang bskur/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'khor lo sdom pa lhan cig skyes pas dbu brgyan/ de la ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba'i thugs kyi phrin las kun// ma lus gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir// 'jigs pa'i skur ston 'dod don ster// dur khrod gnas kyi bdag por bstod// ces pas bstod/

rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya snying gar bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ dpal dur khrod bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs rnams dang bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i gdon bgegs log 'dren rnams tshar bcad pa dang*/ tshe ring nad med longs spyod 'phel zhing chom rkun thams cad bcing ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes pas phrin las bcol/ gtor ma sha khrag dang dar dkar po'i cod pan gyis brgyan pa nang mchod chu chang gis sbyangs la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ stong pa/ āḥthod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba/ hūm̐ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ hoḥs ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par mos la/ ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar mos la/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza gh-i rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ shrī sh+ma sha na a dhi pa ti mahā pi shā tsi na ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa gsum mam bdun gyis phul bas gsol te dges par bsams la/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ nang mchod gtor zhing*/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa zhes sogs gong bzhin brjod nas phrin las bcol/ hūm̐/ rgyal ba'i sogs nas bdag por bstod kyi bar gong bzhin dang*/ rnam dkar keṃ rus dag pa'i gzugs// phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med par// gang la ci 'dod dngos grub kun// nye bar stsol mdzad khyed la bstod// yang dag lam la nyer brten te// lus can bde la 'god mdzad pa'i// srid pa'i 'ching ba kun las skyobs// phan bde kun stsol khyed la bstod// gang gis khyod sgrub khyod mchod na// dam bca' ji bzhin nyer dgongs nas// ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin// bdag la dngos grub ma lus stsol// mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya mtsho'i dang*// dngos grub kun 'byung dam rdzas kyis// dpal ldan bstan srung 'khor bcas mchod// phrin las gang bcol 'grub par mdzod// ces pas bstod// sngags bzla bar 'dod pas rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/

mdun gyi chos skyong lcam dral la phog thugs rgyud bskul/ yab yum gyi thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūm̐ dang am̐ las sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa bkug ste bdag la stsol zhing*/ chom rkun la sogs pa'i gdon dang log 'dren thams cad tshar bcad par mos te/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ zhes ci mang du bzlas pa'i mthar ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa'i mchod bstod dang gsol gdab byas/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ bris sku yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol nas bsrung ba bya/ lam bsrung bar 'dod na 'gro khar yab yum la gtor ma byin la chom rkun chings shig par gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma dgra phyogs su btang*/ rang yi dam du gsal bas gseg ma'am/ bye ma la rtsa sngags la/ chom rkun bhan+dha bhan+dha zhes btags pa mang du bzlas la 'gro phyogs su gtor zhing rang dang 'khor rdzas kun la yang gzhan gyi ma tshor bar cung zad phog par byas nas/ rang 'khor bcas kyi mdun rgyab tu chos skyong yab yum gyi sku dpag tu med pa spros/ dbyug pas dgra bgegs rdul du brlag par byas/ zhags pas yan lag bsdams/ rnam shes dbang po thams cad rmugs shing nyams par byas par mos nas/ rtsa sngags kyi rjes su ma hā tha nu chom rkun bhan+dha bhan+dha swā hā/ zhes bzlas shing rang gis sna drangs nas 'gro/ de nas ci bder bya/ zhes las dang po rnams kyi nyams len du bris pa'o// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi rjes su gnang ba bya ba'i tshul ni/ zla ba yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu bzhi gang rung gnyis la/ mkha' 'gro phyi nang mnyes pa'i mchod gtor/ khyad par 'di'i gtor ma stod zur gsum smad zlum po mtheb kyus bskor ba/ mar la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa dar dkar po'i cod pan dang yab yum gyi tsa ka li btsugs/

chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod bsham/ rang gi mdun du nang mchod rdo dril bzhag de nas rang gis dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod gtor byin gyis brlabs la/ 'das pa'i gtor ma dang chos skyong che chung gi gtor ma rnams 'bul tshar ba'i rjes gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar/ dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi gtor ma dbul/ bzlas pa cung zad bya/ de nas las mgon gyi gtor ma yang phul tshar ba dang*/ bde mchog la sogs pa'i bla med kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'i slob ma dam tshig dang ldan pa gral la 'khod/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/ dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med cing*// yi dam lha yi ngo bo nyid// bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje yis// byin gyis brlab pa stsal du gsol// ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum byed du bcug de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa'i don du/ slob ma rnams gtor chog nas 'byung ba ltar chos skyong yab yum du bskyed/ dngos gzhi la sku gsung thugs gtor ma'i bka' bsgo rnams las/ sku'i rjes gnang gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang dang rang bzhin gyi gnas nas chos skyong yab yum gyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa bkug slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu nas yum gyi mkhar chos skyong yab yum gyi sku dpag tu med par gyur nas khyed rang gi lus la thim par mos pa mdzod byas la/ gu gul gyis bdug dril bu gsil/ yab yum gyi sngags kyi rjes su pra we sha ya hūm̐/ ā we sha ya hūm̐ āḥ zhes mang du bzlas/ sku'i byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod/ de ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// gsung la yang*/

slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros nas yab yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i bar 'dra la/ de nas yi ge ā li kā li dang yab yum gyi sngags su gyur nas khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim par mos te/ sngar ltar dril bu gsil/ yab yum gyi sngags lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byed du bcug bcom ldan bdag la sogs dang*/ slob dpon gyis kyang*/ bcom ldan 'di la sogs bya/ gsung gi byin gyis brlabs par mos pa mdzod byas la/ thugs la yang yum gyi mkhar babs pa'i bar 'dra la/ de nas phyag mtshan gri gug dang rdo rje dang dbyug to dang dgra s+t+wa la sogs pa dpag tu med par gyur nas khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar mtho gang tsam du cung zad gnas te/ de nas thugs kar thim par mos pa mdzod byas la sngags dang dril gsil sngar ltar bya'o// de nas de dag brtan par bya ba'i phyir du gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐ āḥ hūm̐ āḥtiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brjod la nyams gang skyes skyong du bcug de nas gtor ma de kha gsos byin gyis brlabs la phul/ gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ pad+ma badz+ra/ rā hu la/ slob dpon sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ dz+nyā na sid+dhi/ dpal dam tshig rdo rje/ 'chi med blo gros bzang po/ bai ro tsa na/ khams pa rgwa lo tsā ba/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun rin po che/ bla chen yar sgom/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin chen seng ge bzang po/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal ldan rgyal la po sogs pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams dang dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pas slob ma 'di dag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/

sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar du/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang gi las// bsad bskrad dbye rmongs rengs la sogs// ji ltar bsgo ba'i las sgrub cing*// sangs rgyas dam tshig rjes dran mdzod// ces bka' bsgo/ phrin las thams cad sgrub par bsam/ de nas gtso bos ji ltar bka' sogs lan gsum gyi rjes la maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran sogs brjod la/ slob ma rnams btang*/ slob dpon gyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ gtor mgron gshegs gsol bya/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi rgyas gdab bo// dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes su gnang ba bya ba'i rim pa 'di ni/ bla ma dam pa dpal ldan rgyal po'i gsung las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin dge slong sangs rgyas rin chen gyis bris pa'o// ༈ /dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul sa lo'i gsung bzhin bkod pa bzhugs so// bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs gnyis su med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i rjes gnang byed tshul sa lo'i gsung bzhin bri bar bya'o// de la sbyor ba rten dang mchod gtor bsham pa/ dngos gzhi cho ga'i rim pa dngos bstan pa/ rjes kyi bya ba gsum las/ dang po gnas khang yid du 'ong bar bla ma yi dam chos srung gi rten dang khyad par du dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi sku gang 'byor bshams/ mdun du stegs ji ltar rigs pa la yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi gtor ma rang gi phyag len bzhin dang*/ khyad par dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po'i gtor ma pad ma zlum po stod zur gsum rno ba la rtse nyi zla nor bu zur la me ri sogs rgyan ci mdzes dmar rgyan gyis brgyan pa la mda' gtsang ma dar dkar pos brgyan pa'i steng du dpal dur khrod bdag po'i sku tsa ka li rab gnas can btags pa dang*/ gtor ma'i mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga rnams bsham/

rang gi mdun stegs kyi steng du rdor dril/ ḍa ma ru/ nang mchod/ 'thor nas/ slob ma la dgos pa'i maṇ+ḍal me tog sogs dgos pa'i yo byad ma tshang ba med pa 'du bya ba'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi cho ga'i rim pa la gnyis kyi dang po slob dpon gyi bya ba ni/ bde mchog la sogs yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed byas la yi dam gang dgos pa dang*/ gur zhal gyi rjes la dur khrod kyi bdag po 'di nyid kyi gtor ma sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa'i gtor chog bzhin phul/ gzhan yang las mgon sogs gtor ma 'bul ba'i rim pa rang rang gi phyag len bzhin phul tshar ba dang*/ gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba'i rim pa ni/ slob ma rab bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du dbang thob pa/ de ltar min na bla med kyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung bar dbang thob pa bdun la sogs pa khrus byas/ nang du 'ong dus las kyi slob mas rol mo dang*/ gu gul gyi dud pas bdug slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor/ dril bu drag tu dkrol zhing*/ gong du bdag bskyed gang byas kyi rtsa sngags bzlas shing bgegs bskrad/ slob ma rnams gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug bla na med pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la 'dir chos skyong ba'i srung ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod pa'i nang nas/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum 'di ni 'khor lo bde mchog gi bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa yin te/ gsang ba snying gi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi gling gzhi las/ dpal he ru ka skye ba med pa'i ngang las yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang gnyis su med pa sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas te dur khrod chen po'i gnas na dngos grub 'byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/

oṃ shrī he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ shrī badz+ra yo gi nī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsungs pas 'jig rten gyi dregs pa can thams cad brgyal bar gyur to// brgyal sangs pa dang*/ 'khor de rnams kyi nang nas dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po stan las langs te dpal he ru ka la 'di skad ces gsol pa/ kyai/ gdug pa 'dul mdzad he ru ka /bskal pa snyigs ma lnga yi dus// gdug pa can rnams 'khrugs pa dang*// sa bdag klu yi nad rnams dar// ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khrugs pa'i tshe// mi rnams bsod nams longs spyod chung*// rang bsags dngos po spyad dbang med// pha dang bu bral longs spyod nyams// de dus bcom ldan bstan pa 'di// dpa' bo bdag gis bsrung bar bya// zhes gsol ba dang*/ dpal chen he ru kas/ legs so dur khrod bdag po khyod// srog gi snying po bdag la phul// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ zhes mdongs gsol dang bcas srog snying phul zhing*/ dam la btags pa'i srung ma'i dbang po khyad par can dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ dus khyad par can bcu bzhi rnam pa gnyis/ brgyad gnyis gang yang rung ba la bya dgos shing*/ de la slob dpon gyi bya ba yi dam lha'i bdag bskyed dang*/ yi dam chos skyong srung ma rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba/ khyad par dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum la mchod gtor 'bul ba sogs phyag len bzhin legs par grub nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ bla ma dang dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gnyis su med pa la rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum dang dbyer med cing*// yi dam lha yi ngo bo nyid// bla ma dam pa'i thugs rje yi// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// de ltar gsol ba btab nas/

rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog gi bar brjod/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la thog mar sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la dpal 'khor bde mchog dngos yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung pa re byas pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ khyed rang rnams rnams kyi lus la phog pas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de la slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ pad nyi zla ba'i gdan gnyis kyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems kyi ngo bo hūm̐ dang am̐ las dung dang mgron bu hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa sogs gtor chog ltar bskyed/ slar yang slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ u rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sku'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa las/ dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sku dpag tu med par gyur pa sbyor mtshams nas phyir 'thon/

khyed rang rnams kyi lus kyi ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas sib sib thim pa la brten nas sku'i byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ gu gul gyis bdug dril bu sogs rol mo bya/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ pra we sha ya hūm̐/ ā we sha ya aḥ zhes mang du bzlas pas/ de'i rjes gnang thob pas gnas skabs su lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sku'i byin rlabs dang*/ nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi gsung gi rang bzhin rtsa sngags yig 'bru'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa las yi ge ā li kā li dang*/ yum gyi sku dpag tu med par gyur pa sbyor mtshams nas phyir 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin pa nas sib sib thim pa la brten nas gsung gi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod/ sngags dang rol mo bdug pa rnams gong bzhin bya/ de nas bzlas pa'i lung gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams dang slob dpon gnyis ka dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥyig sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/ sngags phreng mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du byung slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rang rnams dur khrod bdag po yab yum du gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/

thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la dang po thim/ gnyis pas byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzad nas/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza ghṛ rā dza ku ma ku ma khuṃ this swā hā/ de nas khyed rang rnams slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pa dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// lan gsum/ slob dpon gyis me tog gi phreng ba sngags kyi phreng bar byin brlabs nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs// bcom ldan 'das kyi byin rlabs ni// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams kyi rgyud la dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin rlabs nus mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod nas slob ma rnams la me tog 'thor/ de rnams kyis gsung gi rjes gnang thob pas/ gnas skabs su gsung gi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug dpal dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon la gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling dang*/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi thugs kyi rang bzhin phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs/ slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes 'od du zhu/

sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa las/ phyag mtshan gyi rnam pa gri gug dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ dbyug pa dang*/ thod pa dang dgra s+t+wa la sogs pa dpag tu med par gyur te/ sbyor mtshams nas phyir 'thon/ khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar mtho gang tsam du cung zad gnas te/ de ma thag thugs kar sib sib thim pa la brten nas thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod byas la/ sngags dang rol mo bdug pa sogs 'dra/ des thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pas gnas skabs su sems kyi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthar thug dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas srod yin na gtor ma la dpal 'bar btsugs/ nyin mo yin na spos rengs btsugs/ las kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag tu gtor ma phul/ slob dpon gyis mgo thog tu 'jog pa dang*/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra hūm̐ āḥ hūm̐ āḥtiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes pa dang*/ gzhan rnams kyis rol mo bdug pa gong bzhin bya/ thams cad tshar ba dang gtor ma sngar shul du bzhag mchod g.yog pas gtor ma gsos la sbyang*/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas gtor sngags gsum gyis phul/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul la/ bdag cag gi rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes phrin las bcol/ slar gtor ma slob dpon gyis bzung la dpal 'bar sogs gong bzhin/ de nas phrin las gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ gtor ma 'di nyid dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gsal ba'i steng gi cha la rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar mngon sum du bzhugs pa yin snyam du gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig byas pas/

rtsa ba'i bla mas bka' bsgos pa bzhin du/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis kyang bka' bsgos shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje 'chang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ pad+ma badz+ra/ rā hu la/ sgeg pa'i rdo rje/ dz+nyā na sid+dhi/ dpal dam tshig rdo rje/ 'chi med blo gros bzang po/ mkhas pa bai ro tsa na/ dpal chen rgwa lo/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ bla chen yar sgom/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ drin can seng ge bzang po/ yar klung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ bla ma bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ rin chen bsod nams chog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ bla ma sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ 'jam mgon gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ dpal sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ gnas gsar ba ngag dbang kun dga' nam mkha' legs pa lhun grub/ drin chen rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang chos 'byor la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sba ba dang*/ 'go ba'i phrin las mdzod cig khyad par sangs rgyas ma thob kyi bar zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las gang bcol pa thams cad 'bad med du sgrub pa dang*/ dam tshig rjes su dran par mdzod cig ces bsgo zhing phrin las sgrub par bsams la/ gtor ma slob ma rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag cing*/

slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud byin gyis brlabs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod/ rol mo bdug pa gong bzhin bya/ thams cad kyi mgo thog tu bzhag tshar ba dang*/ gtor ma dur khrod bdag po yab yum du gsal ba 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas zhugs snying ga'i sa bon la thim pa las khyed rang rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi sku gsung thugs mi 'bral zhing dbyer med du byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams kyi sgo nas rjes su gnang ba zab mo thob pas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la srung sdom tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi 'gro/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang gsan pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya che bar mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang ngo*// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ thun gtor 'bul dgos na phul/ de nas yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ rten yod pa la brtan bzhugs/ rten med pa la gshegs gsol/ gur lha brgyad kyi sku med na lha brgyad rang gi snying gar bsdu/ gnas gsum bsrung ba go bgo ba sogs bdag bskyed dang bstun la bya/ de nas bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o// dpal dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa 'di ni rang gi dran pa gso ba dang*/ rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams spun dang*/ chos tshul 'di la dad pa rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas/ snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i gsung rgyun phyag len gyis brgyan te/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod ldan pa ngag dbang dpal 'byor ga chen no//

//maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
